description: This file is a header file for WLD channel management, defining structures, constants, and function prototypes related to radio channel configuration, management, and reporting in a wireless driver or system component.

classes.name: wld_rad_chanChange_t
classes.description: Structure representing a wireless channel change event, including radio/stream identifiers, previous and new channel specifications, change reasons, and status.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_init
methods.description: Initialize the channel management for a given radio.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_cleanup
methods.description: Cleanup resources related to channel management for a given radio.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_writeDfsChannels
methods.description: Write the current DFS (Dynamic Frequency Selection) channels to PCB.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_reportCurrentChanspec
methods.description: Report the current channel specification for a radio with a specific change reason.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_setTargetChanspec
methods.description: Set a target channel specification for a radio, with options for direct change and reason annotations.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_saveChanges
methods.description: Save current channel changes persistently.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_checkInitChannel
methods.description: Check and initialize the current channel for a radio.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_getCurChannel
methods.description: Retrieve the current channel number for a radio.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_getCurBw
methods.description: Retrieve the current bandwidth setting for a radio.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_getTgtChannel
methods.description: Retrieve the target channel number for a radio.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_getTgtBw
methods.description: Retrieve the target bandwidth for a radio.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_getCurChspec
methods.description: Retrieve the current channel specification for a radio.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_getTgtChspec
methods.description: Retrieve the target channel specification for a radio.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_getAutoBwExt
methods.description: Determine auto bandwidth extension based on mode and maximum bandwidth.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_getAutoBw
methods.description: Determine auto bandwidth based on target channel specification.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_getBetterDefaultChannel
methods.description: Select a better default channel based on frequency band and current/new channels.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_getDefaultSupportedChannel
methods.description: Get default supported channel for a radio.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_getDefaultSupportedBandwidth
methods.description: Get default supported bandwidth for a radio.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_initApplicableRadBwMask
methods.description: Initialize applicable radio bandwidth mask.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_updateApplicableRadBwMask
methods.description: Update the applicable radio bandwidth mask.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_getApplicableRadBwMask
methods.description: Retrieve the applicable radio bandwidth mask.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_getHighestApplicableRadBw
methods.description: Get the highest applicable radio bandwidth.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_getHighestApplicableBw
methods.description: Get the highest supported bandwidth allowed.
